notes: Audit compares raw z and per-bearing first-15-step centered z without retraining the AutoEncoder.
Early/middle/late labels are weak normalized-lifetime bins, not physical damage labels.
Stage classification and lifetime regression use leave-one-bearing-out evaluation with train-only scaling.
Bearing identity uses chronological within-bearing train/test halves and is a leakage diagnostic, not a generalization score.
Only condition 35Hz12kN is present, so operating-condition predictability is not testable in this audit.
All bearings were previously inspected; thresholds are descriptive gates rather than significance tests.
